title: Conference Report and Intelligence Briefing: ACE2025
content:
ACE2025 focused on the future of education amidst ongoing geopolitical and technological disruption from the standpoint of both teaching and learning. Educational reform, higher institutions’ internationalisation efforts, and the teacher, curriculum, and skills of the future were some of the current climate’s pressing issues that require immediate attention, according to these experts.

author: IAFOR
